context: Evaluates correct usage of the spprof Profiler context manager. The candidate must construct Profiler with interval_ms, use it as a context manager, access the profile property after the with-block, and use output_path for auto-saving.

checklist.name: Correct Profiler instantiation
checklist.description: Constructs spprof.Profiler(interval_ms=2) or equivalent with valid interval_ms parameter.

checklist.name: Used as context manager
checklist.description: Uses the Profiler instance with Python's 'with' statement (i.e., 'with spprof.Profiler(...) as p:').

checklist.name: Accesses profile after exit
checklist.description: Accesses p.profile after the with-block and uses it (e.g., prints p.profile.sample_count).

checklist.name: profile is None during profiling
checklist.description: Correctly identifies or tests that p.profile is None while still inside the with-block.

checklist.name: output_path auto-save
checklist.description: Passes output_path='output.json' (or equivalent) to Profiler and verifies the file is written after the context exits.
